SPORT_SEEDS.name: Football (soccer)
SPORT_SEEDS.notes: Sprints, cuts and kicks load the legs hard; keep heavy leg work at least 24 h before a match or hard session and not the day after a match.

SPORT_SEEDS.name: Running
SPORT_SEEDS.notes: Running interferes most with leg training; do easy runs after lifting or on other days and keep intervals away from leg day.

SPORT_SEEDS.name: Boxing
SPORT_SEEDS.notes: Rounds tax shoulders, arms and footwork; avoid heavy pressing right before. Legs are mostly fine.

SPORT_SEEDS.name: Tennis
SPORT_SEEDS.notes: Lateral cuts and serves; treat it like a moderate leg and shoulder day.

SPORT_SEEDS.name: Swimming
SPORT_SEEDS.notes: Low impact and great conditioning; shoulders and lats get extra work.

SPORT_SEEDS.name: Cycling
SPORT_SEEDS.notes: Little eccentric load, so it is the most lifting-friendly cardio, but hard intervals still tire the quads.

SPORT_SEEDS.name: Basketball
SPORT_SEEDS.notes: Jumps and landings are hard on knees and calves; schedule it like football.
